observations: All Loop 4 evidence, platform snapshots, images, tasks, and failures were synthetic and processed offline.
No real Chengfeng host, account, credential, browser profile, request, response, image, or platform write was used.
No legacy project, database, browser profile, launcher, runtime, port, process, or application-data directory was read, executed, attached to, reused, stopped, or changed.
No Windows DNS, proxy, VPN, routing, hosts file, or global browser setting was changed.
No real PaddleOCR, CPU OCR, GPU OCR, CUDA runtime, model, cloud OCR, or production document was loaded.
Every project Python command used the repository .venv.
The formal SQLite database is located only below an explicit DaHe data root and is opened through one managed runtime, engine, and short-transaction commit gate.
An unmanaged or unknown database revision is rejected before mutable SQLite pragmas or migration actions run.
Migration 0001 was not rewritten after it was committed; the lease foreign key and retry-request additions use migration 0002.
Backups and restores use temporary directories, verify SQLite integrity, foreign keys, migration revision, evidence identities, sizes, hashes, and exact active-evidence manifest membership.
Restore does not replace an active database and refuses a nonempty target.

Persistent recovery never treats an expired timestamp alone as authority; instance state, matching data-root identity, lease generation, raw process-local token, and operating-system ownership proof are required where applicable.
Human browser control cannot expire into automated control and requires an explicit matching return.
Scheduler results are fenced before any result or checkpoint write, and database state stores only a SHA-256 of the raw process-local grant token.
Technical failures remain technical failures and are not converted into finance-review business items.
The local API still provides no settlement confirmation, payment, receipt cancellation, automatic ticket exchange, or other Chengfeng write endpoint.
